bibl.title: A few remarks on the persistence of native Egyptian historiolae in Coptic magical texts.
bibl.seg: Krisztina Hevesi, A few remarks on the persistence of native Egyptian historiolae in Coptic magical texts.

Marie Peterková Hlouchová, Dana Belohoubková, Jirí Honzl & Vera Nováková (edd.), Current Research in Egyptology 2018. Proceedings of the Nineteenth Annual Symposium, Czech Institute of Egyptology, Faculty of Arts, Charles University, Prague, 25-28 June 2018 (Oxford, 2019) pp. 42-54.
bibl.note: Introduction. - Coptic manuscripts containing the names of Horus, Isis, and/or Osiris: Some attestations of the Isis-Horus historiola; - References to Isis and Osiris; - Appearance of Isis or Osiris. - Reasons and consciousness: Grouping and context; - Conscious vs. unconscious use; - The great majority of master texts. - Conclusions.
